hints.title: Greedy Shortest Unseen Prefix
hints.text: At each starting position, extend the current substring until the accumulated segment has not appeared in prior partitions.

hints.title: Prefix Recording
hints.text: Store each partitioned substring in a visited collection to prevent identical repetitions.

hints.title: Linear Pointer Progression
hints.text: Advance the scanning pointer immediately past the newly created partition substring.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def partitionString(self, s: str) -> List[str]:
        seen = set()
        ans = []
        i = 0
        n = len(s)
        while i < n:
            curr = ""
            j = i
            while j < n:
                curr += s[j]
                if curr not in seen:
                    break
                j += 1
            seen.add(curr)
            ans.append(curr)
            i = j + 1
        return ans
```
